name: Haus Matt
beschreibung: The Haus Matt welcomes holidaymakers to St. Jakober Dorfstraße in St. Anton am Arlberg. These stylish, modern holiday apartments offer supreme comfort with cosy living areas, peaceful bedrooms, and fully fitted kitchens designed for independent self-catering. Private balconies and terraces provide breathtaking panoramic views across the rugged Arlberg peaks. The peaceful location in the charming hamlet of St. Jakob combines relaxing tranquillity with easy access to the legendary winter sports hub of St. Anton: complimentary ski buses stop just moments away, whisking skiers straight to the lifts of Ski Arlberg. In summer, exhilarating climbing routes, mountain biking circuits, and hiking trails around Galzig and Valluga await.
kurzbeschreibung: Modern holiday apartments in St. Anton am Arlberg in St. Jakob featuring fully equipped kitchens and alpine Arlberg views.
